attempts.response:
WITH matched_outreach AS (
  SELECT 
    o."School Name" AS original_school,
    o."Block",
    o."Students Reached",
    o."Applications Expected",
    o."Contact Teacher",
    o."Date",
    a."Applicant",
    a."Course",
    a."Status",
    a."Marks",
    jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) AS similarity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) DESC) AS rn
  FROM "lpf_outreach" o
  LEFT JOIN "lpf_applications" a ON 1=1
  WHERE jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) >= 0.9
),
best_matches AS (
  SELECT 
    original_school,
    "Block",
    "Students Reached",
    "Applications Expected",
    "Contact Teacher",
    "Date",
    "Applicant",
    "Course",
    "Status",
    "Marks"
  FROM matched_outreach
  WHERE rn = 1
),
school_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    original_school,
    "Block",
    "Students Reached",
    "Applications Expected",
    "Contact Teacher",
    "Date",
    COUNT("Applicant") AS application_count
  FROM best_matches
  GROUP BY original_school, "Block", "Students Reached", "Applications Expected", "Contact Teacher", "Date"
)
SELECT 
  original_school AS "School Name",
  "Block",
  "Students Reached",
  "Applications Expected",
  "Contact Teacher",
  "Date",
  COALESCE(application_count, 0) AS "Applications Count"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    "School Name",
    "Block",
    "Students Reached",
    "Applications Expected",
    "Contact Teacher",
    "Date",
    NULL AS application_count
  FROM "lpf_outreach"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    original_school,
    "Block",
    "Students Reached",
    "Applications Expected",
    "Contact Teacher",
    "Date",
    application_count
  FROM school_counts
) AS combined
GROUP BY "School Name", "Block", "Students Reached", "Applications Expected", "Contact Teacher", "Date", "Applications Count"
ORDER BY "School Name";
